# Kwanda Corporations

> Kwanda Corporations is a Rwanda-origin technology company focused on designing, developing and building digital products, software systems and technology-driven solutions that address real-world challenges. Its work spans transportation technology, education technology, digital payments and cloud infrastructure.

Official website: https://kwandacorporation.com/
Location: Kigali, Rwanda
Tagline: Where software meets art.

## Company

- Legal name: Kwanda Corporations Ltd
- Also known as: Kwanda, Kwanda Corporation, Kwanda Group
- Registered and based in Kigali, Rwanda
- Product-oriented technology company working across software engineering, creativity, innovation and entrepreneurship
- The name Kwanda comes from the Kinyarwanda word for expanding, growing and increasing

## Products

- Katisha — a live digital travel booking platform for East Africa, connecting passengers with transportation operators through digital discovery, online booking, operator integration and digital payments. https://katisha.today
- STRS — Student Transport and Routing System, a proposed system connecting schools, parents, transport operators and education authorities to organise, route and account for student journeys.

## Team

- Manzi Alpe — Chief Executive Officer and founder
- Ashraf Tuyubahe — Chief Technology Officer
- Ntwali Josue — Lead Software Engineer
- Gatare Jean Marie — Operations Manager

## Partners and ecosystem

- MINICT — Rwanda's Ministry of ICT and Innovation
- RURA — Rwanda Utilities Regulatory Authority
- Trinity Express — cross-border bus and courier operator
- Simba Coaches — East African intercity bus operator
- pawaPay — mobile-money payment infrastructure
- OVHcloud — cloud and server infrastructure
- MongoDB Atlas — cloud database infrastructure
- Google Play and App Store — mobile application distribution

## Milestones

- Registered as a business in Kigali, Rwanda
- VAT registration, effective 17 August 2026
- Data protection and privacy registration as a data controller
- Katisha live in real-world use with passengers, bookings and transport operators
- Working relationships with transportation operators including Trinity and Simba
